Looking for a groomer who specializes in the mini schnauzer show cut?
Not Amy’s pet Palace. I have been going there for many years and my groomer is out on maternity leave. I had Amy groom both my Pomeranian and mini schnauzer, I just picked them up. Some how she was able to groom both dogs in 35 minutes. Well my mini schnauzer had one knot in one of her legs and she shaved her entire coat down to nothing, skirt is completely gone, beard is all crooked. I specifically said not to do that. With corn starch and a special comb you can work the knots out. She would not get on the phone and my Pomeranian coat is still wet.
The receptionist said it’s just hair and will grow back. Well you don’t charge almost $200 and just shave a dog down, not get on the phone and not apologize for being lazy.

You need someone with patience and experience with the breed. It will take at least a year for her coat to grow back.
Amazing service ! My dog came out looking and smelling beautiful ! Wouldn’t go anywhere else !!!

I've gone to this place a couple of times before deciding to leave a review. My first impression wasn't great since as I was speaking to the front desk I could hear someone yelling at a dog. I still left my baby there with the benefit of the doubt (also because I had just moved and didn't know of another place). The next couple of times I've gone, my dog had little cuts here and there, I overlooked it because I thought it was maybe normal? Then one specific lady did a great job with no cuts so I thought okay, maybe now that her fur is longer they won't accidentally cut my baby anymore. Wrong. The last time I went, I asked for a specific cut and even showed a picture as reference. I got my dog back SHAVED and with cuts, her face and ears uneven. My baby didn't have any knots or anything for her to have to have been shaved, I asked for a specific cut and get my dog literally shaved in return?! My dog is a calm and sweet girl, I have no idea why they wouldn't even bother to AT LEAST give her an even cut. Her body was shaved and her head barely even touched, she looked ridiculous. I left a respectful text message regarding this and got a call back from a man. He was nice asked me to come in again and have them fix her up but she was shaved down!, what is there to fix? I said I'd just need to wait for her fur to grow again. Once it grew, I called to see if now that it's grown back I could get some kind of compensation for the terrible job they did on her previously, I asked if maybe I could get a small discount since the last time I paid for something I did not get at all (they're pricey, so there shouldn't be a botched job). The lady was rude until I spoke to her extra kindly (which I shouldn't have to do, I was already nothing but respectful every single encounter) and said they don't do that but that she'd leave my contact info for Amy to call me back. Never got a call back. Of course not. Why would they? They don't care about the dogs or owners, only about the money. That's why they're rude, mean to the poor animals, and aren't even careful when it comes to cutting the fur. Overall, they're mean and careless. I would've continued being a loyal customer and overlooked the botched job if they would've given me a call back or been kinder to my dog and I. I found a groomer that does a much better job for a reasonable price and actually treats my dog nicely, which is really all that I cared about from the start.

Do I need to say much might as well shave his whole face instead of leaving it half done paid $125 and he wasn’t knotted to the point where it was needed to shave him down to the skin and told me that I shouldn’t shower my dog in my own home yes she told me I shouldn’t shower my dog in my own home never in my life have I heard someone say that don’t come here this is a scam don’t say I didn’t warn you

This was our first time using Amy’s, and we had a great experience. Our groomer Eileen was very clear in explaining our options for the haircut (this is our first dog that actually has non-wire hair) and helped me pick exactly what I described. Our dog looks and smells great. The front desk was very communicative, with dropoff and pickup being very easy. Pricing is reasonable as well. We will definitely continue to use Amy’s.

This has happened before and we reminded you, but the worst still happened. The way you treated my Goldendoodle was extremely unprofessional. Treated my Goldendoodle very roughly.

We all understand that sometimes dogs can move, but don’t you know when to stop? All you had to do was stop trimming, inform the owner about the situation, instead of forcing him through it. Why would you treat a dog like this—do you have any compassion?

Just look at the pictures: shaved around his abdomen and near the anus, it is absolutely horrific.

My beloved dog has been in so much pain every night that he cannot sleep. ⚠️ Warning: If you don’t want your beloved pet to be treated this way, do not come here.

My experience at Amy's Pet Palace was beyond disappointing—it was infuriating and heartbreaking. The grooming service was an absolute disaster. My dog came back with multiple cuts and visible bleeding, which is utterly unacceptable for a supposed "professional" pet care facility. The haircut was a mess—uneven, patchy, and clearly rushed, showing a complete lack of skill or attention to detail. It’s obvious they cut corners, and my pet suffered as a result.

Worse still, Amy, the owner, was shockingly rude and unprofessional. When I raised concerns about my dog’s injuries, she was not only dismissive but outright hostile, blaming my dog for being "difficult" and telling me never to come back. Her condescending tone and refusal to take accountability were appalling—I've never encountered such blatant disrespect from a business owner. It’s clear she has no interest in customer satisfaction or animal welfare, only in taking your money for shoddy work.

The facility itself is disorganized and feels unprofessional, with no regard for maintaining a safe or welcoming environment. Charging premium prices for such abysmal service is nothing short of a scam. As an animal lover, I’m horrified by how poorly they treat pets and their owners. I strongly urge everyone to avoid Amy's Pet Palace at all costs—your pets deserve better care and respect. If I could give zero stars, I would. Save yourself the regret and stay far away!

BEWARE!!! Will your dogs grooming come out great?.. yes!.. Will they also be abusing your dog while they do it....YES!!!.. I brought my dog to be groomed today and this is now the SECOND time I saw a groomer mishandling a pet. The first time I was so mad at myself for not saying anything, but this time I was furious...With my own eyes I saw this little white dog have both of his ears grabbed and his head pulled back so hard just so she can brush his face (blonde girl with short hair wish I knew her name).. I was livid beyond belief and said something to the two people at the front desk AND the groomer when I walked in.. all of which were basically ignoring me and then I come to find out that one of the people overhearing me was THE OWNER!!.. if that was my shop I would be apologizing and also ADDRESSING the issue right there and then with the worker that was mishandling.. I don't even care if the dog was being "bad" (which is what I was told could have been the case, but that dog definitely was not) I even called and text afterwards to speak to the owner in which the receptionist spoke to me very nicely, but the owner should have been on that phone and never called me back.. I guess I would be embarrassed too knowing that my workers are inadequate and I was to scared to do anything about it.. It's unfortunate because this place is very convenient and my dogs do come out clean and groomed when I take them.. but if they are being handled inappropriately in the process then NO THANK YOU.... I just hope other owners think twice... last time ill be going there....
